tools.name: list_tracks
tools.title: List learning tracks
tools.description: List all SparkCoder learning tracks (ServiceNow Dev, Admin, IRM, Java, AngularJS) with their IDs, titles, and short descriptions. Public — no auth required.

tools.name: list_practice_questions
tools.title: List practice questions
tools.description: List SparkCoder practice questions. Optionally filter by category id (e.g. 'gliderecord', 'streams', 'grc-tables', 'ng-directives'). Returns id, category, prompt, and difficulty. Public — no auth required.

category.description: Optional category id to filter by. Omit for all categories.

tools.name: get_my_progress
tools.title: Get my progress
tools.description: Return the signed-in SparkCoder user's saved progress (XP, streaks, solved puzzles, badges). Requires sign-in.

tools.name: save_my_progress
tools.title: Save my progress
tools.description: Replace the signed-in SparkCoder user's saved progress blob. Pass the full progress object you want stored (XP, streaks, solved puzzles, etc.); it overwrites the previous value. Requires sign-in.

data.description: The full progress object to persist for this user.

tools.name: list_my_feedback
tools.title: List my feedback
tools.description: List the signed-in user's own SparkCoder feedback / issue reports and their current status (open, in_progress, resolved) plus any admin note. Requires sign-in.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.title: Submit feedback
tools.description: Create a new SparkCoder feedback / issue report for the signed-in user. Screenshots aren't supported through MCP — attach them from the /feedback page in the app. Requires sign-in.

description.description: Detailed description of the issue or feedback.

page_url.description: Optional URL of the page the feedback is about.
